subject: Startups
title: Protective Provisions
description: A quick win: understand Protective Provisions.

hook.text: Even minority investors can block major decisions.

buildup.text: Common provisions: veto on new fundraising, acquisitions, changes to the charter, or issuing new share classes.

discovery.text: These provisions protect investors from founders taking actions that destroy value—like selling the company cheaply.

twist.text: But they can also create deadlock. A disagreement over a pivot can freeze the company if the investor won't approve it.

climax.text: Founders should negotiate the scope carefully. Too many provisions create a co-pilot you didn't want in the cockpit.

punchline.text: Protective provisions protect investors. Make sure they don't paralyze you.

quiz.question: What do protective provisions give investors?
options: Veto power over specific major company decisions
